plainText:
Brock's Comfey (Japanese: タケシのキュワワー Takeshi's Cuwawa) was the only that obtained in the Alola region, and his eleventh overall, having received it as a from Nurse Joy.

==History==
=== ===
 
In Alola, Alola!, Brock was given Comfey from the Melemele Island Nurse Joy as thanks for his help at the Pokémon Center. 

It was first used in Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone! to help him calm down an angry mother that was protecting her injured baby, which it did by using . Comfey then helped Brock treat the injured baby Kangaskhan, handing him medicine and bandages.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
As with all of its species, Comfey has been shown to be kind and caring, as well as able to calm down angry Pokémon. Comfey has a good amount of skill dealing with injured Pokémon, helping both and Nurse Joy treat injured and upset Pokémon.

==Moves used==
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Comfey is the first belonging to one of Ash's friends whose capture was not revealed in the episode it was obtained in.
Comfey is the lightest and shortest Pokémon currently owned by a main character.
Comfey is Brock's only known Pokémon that:
He has obtained since he stopped traveling with .
Has no evolutionary line.
Is a type.
Has not been shown using any offensive moves.
Was introduced after Generation IV.
Has not appeared outside of its debut series.
Comfey's capture marks the first time one of Ash's friends obtain a new Pokémon within the main series following their retirement from the main cast.
Comfey is Brock's Pokémon with the least amount of appearances, having appeared in only one episode to date.
